```{r}
library(exactextractr)
exact_extract(x = cdl_2009, y = huc8, progress = FALSE, fun = function(value, fraction) {
sum(fraction[value==1], na.rm = TRUE)
})

```

```{r}

res(cdl_2009)

res(cdl_2009)[1]

crop_areas$corn <- exact_extract(cdl_2009, huc8, progress=FALSE,function(value, fraction) {
sum(fraction[value==1], na.rm=TRUE)*res(cdl_2009)[1]*res(cdl_2009)[1]/1000000
})
head(crop_areas,3)
```

```{r}
crop_areas$soybeans <- exact_extract(cdl_2009, huc8, progress=FALSE,function(value, fraction) {
sum(fraction[value==5], na.rm=TRUE)*res(cdl_2009)[1]*res(cdl_2009)[1]/1000000
})
head(crop_areas,3)

```

```{r}
crop_areas$year <- "2009"
head(crop_areas,3)
```

```{r}
for (i in c("2010","2011","2012","2013","2014","2015","2016","2017","2018","2019","2020")){
# 1. Create data frame object called 'areas'
areas <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 4, nrow = 52))
# 2. Specify column names
colnames(areas) <- c('HUC8', 'corn', 'soybeans','year')
# 3. Load CDL for a given year i
cdl <- raster(paste0("data/cdl/usda_crop_data_layer_",i,".tif"))
# 4. Project CDL into same crs as huc8 object
#cdl <- projectRaster(cdl, crs=st_crs(huc8)$epsg)
# 5. Calculate area planted with corn in sqkm
areas$corn <- exact_extract(cdl, huc8, progress=FALSE,
function(value, fraction) {
sum(fraction[value==1], na.rm=TRUE)*res(cdl)[1]*res(cdl)[1]/1000000
})
# 6. Calculate area planted with soybeans in sqkm
areas$soybeans <- exact_extract(cdl, huc8, progress=FALSE,
function(value, fraction) {
sum(fraction[value==5], na.rm=TRUE)*res(cdl)[1]*res(cdl)[1]/1000000
})
# 7. Populate year column
areas$year <- i
# 8. Populate HUC8 column
areas$HUC8 <- huc8$HUC8
# 9. Append to 'crop_areas' data frame object
crop_areas <- rbind(crop_areas,areas)
}
head(crop_areas, 3)
# Write final data to .csv file
write.csv(crop_areas,paste0("data/crop_areas.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
```
